note: eDamage Stone holds no inputs of its own -- it mirrors eDamage ({eDamage!AT12:AY71} for the controls, {eDamage!BB3:BM50} for every lab level) and differs only in what a level costs. So the account is written to eDamage and the path is read here. Accounts use the SAME seed as the eDamage sweep, so account-N is the same player in both.
